{{External|rs|rsc=Bandit Camp}} {{otheruses|a camp in the [[Wilderness]]|the camp in the [[Kharidian Desert]]|Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)}} {{Infobox Location |name = Bandit Camp |image = [[File:Bandit Camp (Wilderness).png|300px]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = No |location = [[Wilderness]] |race = [[Humans]] |teleport = [[Burning amulet]] |music = {{*}} [[Map:Wilderness music|Wilderness tracks]]
{{*}} [[Army of Darkness]] (Classic mode) |map = {{Map|name=Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|x=3037|y=3685|height=300|width=300|zoom=1}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Wilderness }} {{Relativelocation |location = Bandit Camp |north = Wilderness God Wars Dungeon |west = Ruins (west) |south = Dark Warriors' Fortress |east = Graveyard of Shadows }} The '''Bandit Camp''' is an outlaw stronghold located within levels 17-24 [[Wilderness]]. It is most commonly visited to kill [[bandits]] for a [[Krystilia]] Slayer task, and to sell items to the [[Bandit Duty Free|general store]]. The southern entrance is guarded by level 22 and level 130 [[bandit]]s, and the eastern entrance is guarded only by two [[giant rat]]s, making it the much safer entrance. ==Transportation== Several methods of transport bring players to the camp, listed here from least to most walking involved: * {{Plink|Burning amulet}} — southern camp entrance. * {{Plink|Dareeyak Teleport}} — western ruins, just west of the camp. * {{Plink|Ring of dueling}} — [[Ferox Enclave]], south-east of the camp. * {{Plink|Cemetery Teleport}} — Forgotten Cemetery, north-west of the camp. * {{Plink|Hunter cape}} — [[Wilderness Hunter area|Wilderness hunter area]], north-east of the camp. * {{plink|Canoe|pic=Paddle}} — [[Wilderness Hunter area|Wilderness hunter area]], north-east of the camp. * {{Plink|Revenant cave teleport}} — [[Revenant Caves]], fairly north-west of the ruins. ==History== Little information regarding the history of this camp is known. Most of the camp seems to have been destroyed; many of the buildings are falling apart. It may be the remains of a fortified city destroyed during the [[God Wars]] (possibly part of the nearby ruins of [[Dareeyak]]), as many other ruins located in the Wilderness are. The camp is considered highly dangerous, so dangerous that tax collectors don't visit.{{CiteNPC|npc=Noterazzo|quote=The general stores in Asgarnia and Misthalin are heavily taxed. It really makes it hard for them to run an effective business. For some reason taxmen don't visit my store.|loc=|notes=|name=}} Because of this isolation, the camp is also used as a hideout by those who are on the run from the law. [[Fat Tony]], who was accused of giving the [[King Roald|king]] food poisoning and had to flee [[Misthalin]], receives refuge at the camp in exchange for providing his cooking services to the bandits.{{CiteNPC|npc=Fat Tony|quote=Well I'm an outlaw. I was accused of giving the king food poisoning! The thought of it! I think he just drank too much wine that night. I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin! The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.|loc=|notes=|name=}} ==Locations== === Shops === * [[Bandit Duty Free]] is a [[general store]] that buys at higher and sells at lower prices than other general stores. * [[Neil]] sells [[Team cape|Wilderness team capes]] ending in the number 7. He is located in or around the remains of the building immediately north of Bandit Duty Free. * [[Tony's Pizza Bases]] sells [[pizza base]]s, and a [[tomato]] and [[cheese]] spawn on the table next to a stove where pizzas can be created. [[Meat pizza]]s can be cooked using the meat from the rats on the eastern entrance to the camp. === Skill training areas === * The area has a number of bandits, making a bandit Slayer task go very quickly when using a [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]]. * The [[small fishing net]] spot to the east of the pizza shop can be used to catch anchovies, allowing players to make [[anchovy pizza]]s. * There are four permanent [[Fire|fires]] and a [[range]], which can be used to train cooking. The range is both safe from bandits, and has a lower burn rate, so is recommended for use over the fires. {| class="wikitable" !Item !Spawns !Locations !Map |- |{{Plink|Cheese}} |1 |Tony's Pizza Bases |{{map|3039,3707|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Cheese}} |- |{{Plink|Tomato}} |1 |Tony's Pizza Bases |{{map|3039,3706|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Tomato}} |} [[File:South entrance to Bandit Camp (Wilderness).png|300px|thumb|The south entrance of the bandit camp.]] ==Inhabitants== === Personalities === * {{Chatl|Fat Tony}}, the camp's chef. * {{Chatl|Neil}}, who sells team capes. * {{Chatl|Noterazzo}}, the owner of the camp's general store. === Monsters and attackable NPCs === * [[Bandit]] (x23) * [[Black Heather]] * [[Donny the lad]] * [[Giant rat]] (x2) * [[Guard Bandit|Guard bandit]] (x4) * [[Speedy Keith]] ==Music== {| class="wikitable sortable" !Name ! class="unsortable" |Unlock location ! class="unsortable" |Music track |- |All [[Wilderness#Music|Wilderness songs]] (except [[Pirates of Peril]]) |[[Wilderness]] |N/A |} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 13 March 2014 |update = Rejuvenating the Wilderness: More risk, more reward |poll = Old School feature poll 15: Rejuvenating the Wilderness |change = High level bandits have been added to the Bandit Camp. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Bandit Camp (Wilderness)}} {{Wilderness}} [[Category:Bases and camps]]
